name: Android Mobile Application
description: Orchestration profile for Android/Kotlin applications using Gradle and Android Emulator.

tools.name: gradle
tools.description: Gradle build system (typically invoked via ./gradlew in the consumer repository).

tools.name: adb
tools.description: Android Debug Bridge for communicating with the Android Emulator.

candidate_checks.description: Run Android unit tests on the JVM.
Run static analysis to detect lifecycle, resource, and security issues on Android.
Run instrumented integration tests on the Android Emulator (when required by the repository).

expected_evidence: Actual exit codes of the Gradle test/lint tasks accepted by the repository
Scope verification of modified files and git diff --check output
Evidence triage report from Jev (jev-1.13.0) and evaluation from a fresh reviewer
special_risks: Activity/View Context leaks during screen rotation or improper CoroutineScope lifecycle cancellation
Performing blocking I/O or heavy decoding on Dispatchers.Main causing ANRs
Modifying permissions, exported components in AndroidManifest.xml, or ProGuard/R8 configuration
quant_escalation_required_when: Computing or validating PnL, funding, liquidation, margin, or risk logic directly in the application
